art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Nautilus is a huge rounded deep-sea diving suit with a brass helmet, softly glowing circular eye windows, heavy shoulder plates, and enormous covered hands and boots. Preserve his oversized anchor and chain as a grounded resting prop, without menace. Retain this champion's distinctive silhouette and recognizable accessories, softened into friendly rounded shapes with opaque clothing wherever appropriate.
art_direction.scene: He kneels on a broad quiet harbor platform and studies a tiny pink shell cupped in one gloved palm. His anchor lies flat beside a neatly coiled chain, with calm blue water and one simple mooring post behind. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: brass, deep teal, sea blue, shell pink, warm cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
